banner.title: kube-prometheus-stack
banner.tagline: Scrapes the cluster every minute, evaluates the alert rules and keeps 14 days of metrics for Grafana and the pagers.

art.about: how Prometheus scrapes, stores and alerts on cluster metrics
art.title: How kube-prometheus-stack watches the cluster

explainer.title: From a ServiceMonitor to a page

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: Every ServiceMonitor, PodMonitor and Probe in every namespace is selected, with no release label needed. The chart adds kubelet, the API server and node-exporter.
steps.scene: a radar sweep over a grid of server racks

steps.title: Scrape
steps.text: Prometheus pulls each target once a minute into a TSDB on a 55 GiB volume. High-cardinality series are dropped at scrape time.
steps.scene: streams of data points flowing into a cylinder database

steps.title: Evaluate
steps.text: Rules under alerts/ and the chart's rules are evaluated every 30 seconds, the operator default. Three chart rules are replaced by recency-bound copies that keep their names.
steps.scene: a ledger page with checkmarks and a small bell

steps.title: Alert
steps.text: Firing alerts are sent to Alertmanager on port 9093 over the v2 API. Severity decides what pages, so critical is priority 2.
steps.scene: a bell ringing with a signal wave

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Grafana and kromgo query Prometheus in-cluster. The web UI is on envoy-internal, behind the internal route only.
steps.scene: a dashboard gauge panel behind a padlock
